name: Casper Mountain County Park - Elkhorn Springs Campground
note: Natrona County campground on Casper Mountain, on a dirt road off Casper Mountain Road with Elkhorn Spring running through it; the sites sit under pines and aspens, each with a fire ring and picnic table. The county publishes no site lengths; a 2026 Google reviewer called site EH 1 a good spot for longer vehicles or a trailer, but confirm fit with the Parks Department. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: Natrona County Parks Rec1 catalog (secure.rec1.com/WY/natrona-county-wy/catalog, public getTabs/getItems/getLocationFacilities JSON, tab 12056 'Casper Mountain', group 24915 'Elkhorn Springs', read 2026-11-20): 'Elkhorn Springs campground is located off of Casper Mountain Road. The campground is surrounded by pine trees and aspens. The Elkhorn Spring runs through the campground. Elkhorn Springs has 6 campsites. Each campsite has a fire ring and a picnic table. $13.39 a night plus taxes and fees', 'Reservation Only. Available 90 days in advance', 'Closed for winter. Reopens 5/28/2027'; 6 bookable items EH Site 01-06 at a 2026 'Nightly Rate' of $13.39. Google Maps 'Elkhorn Springs Campground' (42.73772,-106.31645, the county's own 'Directions' link; website = this Rec1 group), 4.4 on 66 reviews; a review dated ~Jul 2026 on site EH 1: 'Lots of room ... Great spot for longer vehicles or pulling a trailer'; an older review describes a fifth wheel parked in a reserved spot. County silent on rig length -> kept with a caveat under the AWH 2026-11-02 unclear-pad rule; no agency road warning found (county pages 403, unread). The Dyrt lists only 'Tent Sites' (one 2023 review, no rig named) - aggregator tag, outweighed by the drive-in road and the 2026 review. Public (local): no price gate.
waterfront_evidence: 2026-11-20: Esri World Imagery frames rendered at 42.73772,-106.31645 (~200 m half-width), 42.7395,-106.3155 (~150 m) and 42.7384,-106.3163 (~110 m): a gravel parking lot at the Casper Mountain Road junction and a dirt campground road running NE into dense pine forest, with a narrow grassy wet strip (the spring's drainage, a trickle with no visible open water) along the road's NW side; no site pads visible under the canopy, so no named site can be placed within ~50 m of the stream over open ground. USGS topo shows only a small Elkhorn Creek headwater here. The county's 'Elkhorn Spring runs through the campground' is operator prose, not a site-level basis. Default down -> not waterfront (creekside would need a site-level source).
fees_source: Rec1 group 24915 'Elkhorn Springs' ('$13.39 a night plus taxes and fees'); getLocationFacilities: all 6 sites 'Nightly Rate' base_fee 13.39, 2026-01-01..2026-12-31, read 2026-11-20.
sites_source: Rec1 group 24915 ('Elkhorn Springs has 6 campsites'; itemCount 6, items EH Site 01-06), read 2026-11-20.
hookups_source: Rec1 tab 12056 'Casper Mountain' ('Water is not available at any of the Casper Mountain Campgrounds.'), read 2026-11-20. Electric/sewer not stated for this campground, so omitted.

facilities_source: Rec1 tab 12056 ('Restroom facilities are provided at each Casper Mountain Campground. Water is not available at any of the Casper Mountain Campgrounds.'), read 2026-11-20. Toilet type (vault/flush) not stated.

booking.note: Reservation only, online (Rec1) or through the county Parks Department.

booking_source: Rec1 group 24915 ('Reservation Only. Available 90 days in advance.') + tab 12056 ('Casper Mountain Campgrounds are by reservation only'); Rec1 site photos (EH Site 01-06, EXIF Sep 2022) show each site's sign 'EH n / 10 DAY CAMPING LIMIT / ENJOY YOUR STAY / RESERVATIONS REQUIRED', read 2026-11-20.
flags: Rig fit unverified: the county publishes no site lengths and its campground map (natronacounty-wy.gov DocumentCenter/View/6373, shared with Skunk Hollow) was not fetched (site refuses). Support for drive-in RV use is a Google review (~Jul 2026) of site EH 1 ('Great spot for longer vehicles or pulling a trailer') and an older review mentioning a fifth wheel in a reserved spot. The Dyrt tags it 'Tent Sites' only (crowd tag, one 2023 review). Kept with a caveat under the AWH 2026-11-02 unclear-pad rule; the reviewer may prefer to hold it.

Pin moved ~75 m NE of the county's/Google's point (42.73772,-106.31645, a gravel lot at the Casper Mountain Road junction) onto the campground's dirt road; site positions under the canopy are not visible in imagery.

~0.6 km NW of 6530 Beartrap and ~0.9 km NW of 15733 Deer Haven; a separately named Rec1 facility with its own 6 sites (EH 01-06), so its own entry like Deer Haven, not a duplicate. Skunk Hollow (lead 12, Strube Loop, county directions point 42.74109,-106.31966, ~400 m NW) shares the county map PDF and Google has no separate Skunk Hollow place - the Elkhorn Springs Google listing's 66 reviews include at least one about Skunk Hollow, so the 4.4 is not Elkhorn Springs' alone.
Waterfront held at not waterfront although the county says Elkhorn Spring runs through the campground: no site can be placed on the stream. A site-level source could earn creekside.
Electric not stated for this campground (only 'Water is not available' is park-wide), so hookups carries water false only; toilet type not sourced.
